mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM graph_outbox_event WHERE status = #{status}

SELECT event_id, achievement_id, desired_version, event_type, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, last_error_code AS error_code, last_error_summary AS error_summary, replay_of_event_id, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM graph_outbox_event WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT event_id, achievement_id, desired_version, event_type, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, last_error_code AS error_code, last_error_summary AS error_summary, replay_of_event_id, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM graph_outbox_event WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM graph_outbox_event WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MIN(created_at), #{now}) FROM graph_outbox_event WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')
SELECT MAX(completed_at) FROM graph_outbox_event WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED'
SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM graph_maintenance_run WHERE run_type = 'FULL_REBUILD' AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED') )
